clips.send: Cell theory and its timeline. 1) All living things are made of one or more cells. 2) The cell is the basic unit of structure and function. 3) All cells come from pre-existing cells. Hooke 1665 (cork, named “cells”), Leeuwenhoek 1670s (first living cells), Schleiden 1838 (plants), Schwann 1839 (animals), Virchow 1855 (cells from cells). Better microscopes made each discovery possible.

clips.send: 植物细胞与动物细胞。两者都有：细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核、线粒体、核糖体、内质网、高尔基体、液泡。 只有植物有：细胞壁、叶绿体、一个大的中央液泡（形状方正）。 动物细胞：没有细胞壁，液泡小，常有溶酶体，形状较圆。
